subject.title: RFC 0025: Claw setup, personalization, and Control UI

question: Should this RFC be accepted now as the experimental schema-v2 setup and Control UI direction, or remain draft until the portable-core addendum and upgrade contract are explicitly agreed?
rationale: The patch is an RFC rather than an implementation defect: accepting its new persisted setup state, seed semantics, and UI contract requires product and compatibility ownership that cannot be inferred from documentation alone.

options.title: Keep it draft pending prerequisite
options.body: Defer acceptance until https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/48 and the v1-to-v2 migration, regeneration, and downgrade boundaries are agreed.

options.title: Accept the experimental direction
options.body: Approve the RFC as the implementation target, with the stated server-owned lifecycle and compatibility constraints treated as binding for follow-up PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep it draft pending prerequisite
recommendation.body: Defer acceptance until https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/48 and the v1-to-v2 migration, regeneration, and downgrade boundaries are agreed.

likelyOwner.reason: The RFC process history makes this the best available routing point for an acceptance and sequencing decision.
